facts.name: Chubby Cattle BBQ
facts.label: Chubby Cattle
facts.tagline: Their first Bay Area shop: all-you-can-eat Japanese wagyu barbecue in Silver, Gold and Diamond tiers, with sushi and a self-serve station.

sections.name: All-you-can-eat (per person)
items: Member price $49.99. Unlimited full-blood thick-cut wagyu short rib, wagyu brisket, top blade, knuckle, steak and finger meat, miso wagyu chuck eye, M8-9 wagyu otoro, wagyu skirt steak, wagyu cubes, thin-sliced beef tongue, pork belly, Iberico pork and chicken cartilage, plus the items for all tiers.

Member price $65. Everything in Silver, plus one special meat per person (A5 Miyazaki wagyu short rib, A5 wagyu otoro thick cut, A5 Miyazaki ribeye, A5 finger meat or full-blood wagyu steak), one special dish (A5 wagyu foie gras nigiri or A5 wagyu uni caviar nigiri), unlimited A5 brisket, A5 knuckle, beef tongue platter, tender meats and lamb chop, and scallop.
Member price $75. Everything in Gold and Silver, plus two special meats per person (the Gold choices and A5 striploin 2oz) and two special dishes.

sections.name: To-go: Wagyu Rice Boxes
items: Wagyu over rice with Japanese curry sauce.
Wagyu over rice with a miso-style sauce.
Wagyu patty with fresh toppings and their sauce.

sections.name: To-go: Fried Bites & Appetizers
items: Octopus balls with savory sauce and bonito.

sections.name: To-go: Sushi
items: Two each of salmon, yellowtail, tuna and seared wagyu.

sections.name: To-go: Poke Bowls
items: Salmon with rice, greens and poke toppings.

sections.name: To-go: Bento Boxes
items: Japanese Curry Wagyu & Onion Wagyu Bowl

facts.siteNote: Their first Bay Area shop, in the Pacific Pearl centre on Stoneridge Drive. All-you-can-eat prices are per person from the menu on their own site; the tiers share seafood, sushi, hot dishes and a self-serve station. 90-minute seating (last call at 70); 18% gratuity for 6 or more; under 100 cm eat free, 100–130 cm half price; seniors 65+ 20% off; leftovers add 20%. To-go prices are from their own Chowbus pickup page.
